top_signals.title: How Mexico Locked In Its Militarized Police State
top_signals.summary:
In 2021, Andrew Ivey wrote, “‘I Have Other Data’: The Guardia Nacional and the Entrenchment of Mexico’s Militarization’,” where he warned Mexico was headed toward a militarization trap.
